hero.subtitle1: A festival for those who have something to say —

manifeste.desc1: Genius is born from resistance, never from abundance.
manifeste.desc2: MARSAI dictates a single rule: one minute, one AI, one truth.
manifeste.desc3: What you achieve within this frame will be greater than you believed possible.
manifeste.c1_desc: Every work is limited to 60 seconds. The time constraint is the first of creative freedoms.
manifeste.c2_desc: No real filming. The entire film — visuals, sound, narrative — is generated by artificial intelligence.
manifeste.c3_desc: Despite the tools, the emotion must be true. AI is the brush. Humanity remains the subject.
